Class GameResultsDAO

java.lang.Object
mesos.am30.db.GameResultsDAO
public class GameResultsDAO extends Object
Game Results Data Access Object.
This Class works as the DAO for the Game Results.
It queries the DBConnection in order to get the results of the Ranking Query, then filters for the wanted request.

  • Method Details

    • queryGlobalRanking

      public static List<Map<String,String>> queryGlobalRanking(int playersNumber) throws IOException, SQLException
      Query the Global Ranking for games with N Players.
      This static method works by querying the DB, in order to get the Global Ranking of all Players (identified by the field "Nickname") who have take part in at least one game with a given number of Players.
      For the Players who have taken part in more than one Game, will be taken in account only the best Score.
      Pre: playersNumber >= 2 && playersNumber <= 5
      Parameters:
      playersNumber - Number of Players of the Games to take in account.
      Returns:
      List of rows like (NICKNAME, SCORE, RANK).
      Throws:
      IOException - The DB cannot be instantiated correctly.
      SQLException - The DB connection cannot be established correctly.

    • queryPlayerRank

      public static Map<String,String> queryPlayerRank(int playersNumber, String nickname) throws IOException, SQLException
      Query the Rank of a Player for games with N Players.
      This static method works by querying the DB, in order to get the Rank of a given Player (identified by the field "Nickname") who have take part in at least one game with a given number of Players.
      If the Player has taken part in more than one Game, will be taken in account only the best Score.
      Pre: playersNumber >= 2 && playersNumber <= 5 && nickname != null
      Parameters:
      playersNumber - Number of Players of the Games to take in account.
      nickname - Nickname of the Player.
      Returns:
      Single Row like (NICKNAME, SCORE, RANK).
      Throws:
      IOException - The DB cannot be instantiated correctly.
      SQLException - The DB connection cannot be established correctly.

    • addNewResults

      public static void addNewResults(List<Map<String,String>> results) throws IOException, SQLException
      Add the Results of a new Game to the DB.
      This static method works by first creating a new Game for the given number of players; then adding their Scores.
      Pre: ( /forall playerResult : results; ; playerResults.get("Nickname") != null && playerResults.get("Score") != null )
      Parameters:
      results - Results of the Game as a List of Rows like (Nickname, Score)
      Throws:
      IOException - The DB cannot be instantiated correctly.
      SQLException - The DB connection cannot be established correctly.
